text: The full actual1472 landing already uses setNotificationData with bottom-spaces-toolbar and bottom-today-pane. It toggles both allowed classes and adds the spaces-toolbar default for missing or unsupported values. The first sentence of lesson3f3400335c6029babb57f6dea86ba23c9fbb65a5305d2fb7be3c56b9eebc4ca1 incorrectly described notifications-bottom/notifications-top and an old showNotification owner. Those names are not this landing. The focused advice to test transitions and stale-class removal remains useful: the inspected tests assert positive membership, while source toggles both classes. In D231274 the JavaScript fallback is retained after a CSS alternative is discussed; no arbitrary payload string becomes a DOM class. No test, layout or accessibility execution was performed.
title: Correct the historical notification position names and update method
